requires: gpt-5.6-terra reasons by default: leave effort out and it runs at medium, so calls get slower and spend reasoning tokens. To keep a non-reasoning call's behaviour, set reasoning_effort: "none" in Chat Completions or reasoning.effort: "none" in Responses.
Function tools in Chat Completions work on gpt-5.6-terra only at effort none. At the default medium they are incompatible: set reasoning_effort: "none", or move the call to the Responses API.
The API reference marks functions and function_call deprecated in favor of tools and tool_choice. Move them too.

Token caps now include reasoning: max_completion_tokens and max_output_tokens cover reasoning tokens as well as text, so a small cap can run out before any visible text, and the reasoning is still billed. Responses then returns status incomplete (reason max_output_tokens). Chat Completions returns finish_reason length; empty content there is a reading. OpenAI suggests reserving at least 25,000 tokens when starting out. Raise small caps, including any value carried over from max_tokens, or set effort none, and handle the cut-off case.

Replace max_tokens with max_completion_tokens in Chat Completions. The API reference marks max_tokens deprecated and not compatible with o-series models; it does not name gpt-5.6-terra, so a rejection on gpt-5.6-terra is a reading, not on the page.
The API reference says stop is not supported with o3 and o4-mini. It does not name gpt-5.6-terra, so a rejection on gpt-5.6-terra is a reading. Test any stop value.

With manual history, resend every prior input and output item with its type, ID and call ID, or set reasoning.context to current_turn. With store: false, replay the encrypted reasoning items.

Replace prompt_cache_retention with prompt_cache_options.ttl: 30m by default, 12h in Responses only. Unsupported values return 400. If a request builder is shared with older models, send these fields only on the GPT-5.6 route.

The implicit breakpoint now sits at the end of the latest message, so a stable prefix before a changing suffix can lose hits. GPT-5.6 runs cyber and biology classifiers on output as it is generated. They can block or refuse a request, or pause a stream for several seconds. Handle a refusal, and allow for the pause in stream timeouts (the timeout step is a reading).

entries.what: The Assistants API, including threads, runs and run steps, is gone.

source.quote: Assistants API was officially sunset on August 26, 2026

requires: Threads become Conversations: client.conversations.create({ items }). A conversation stores items, not only messages.
Runs become Responses: client.responses.create. There is no run to poll: you send input items and get output items back.
Your code now runs the tool call loop itself, including sending tool outputs back and handling retries.
Run steps become Items, which can be messages, tool calls or outputs. Read those instead of run steps.

Old threads cannot be read back: the guide says the call that retrieves thread messages no longer works. Only history you stored yourself can seed a new conversation.

OpenAI suggests reserving at least 25,000 tokens when starting out. Raise small caps, including any value carried over from max_tokens, or set effort none, and handle the cut-off case.

Replace prompt_cache_retention with prompt_cache_options.ttl set to "30m".

GPT-5.6 runs cyber and biology classifiers on output as it is generated. They can block or refuse a request, or pause a stream for several seconds. Handle a refusal, and allow for the pause in stream timeouts (the timeout step is a reading).
If the app serves end users, send a stable safety_identifier. The API reference says user is being replaced by safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key.

Omitted or auto image detail now keeps original dimensions, so images can use more tokens, and an image over 30,000 patches is rejected, not resized. Set detail or resize images. In Responses, a PDF with omitted or auto detail can use high page-image detail.
